Current milestone state — updated 2026-11-25.

VERSION: v1.3.0 stable (2026-07-23) still current — the installed rvr is 1.3.0, so bootstraps stay pre-#191 (persisted, read back from a file) until v1.4.0 ships. Unreleased on main: #190, #191, action bumps #199/#200/#201/#214, bun batch #217, #218 (#211), #219 (#207), #220, #221, #222, the docs refresh (#223 + 53e52ab), the 2026-11-25 merges #228–#235, and #236 (dependency advisories cleared, CodeQL #17) and #238 (a failed Security scan opens an issue). As of the end of 2026-11-25 there are no open PRs and no branch but main, local or remote; main is 272d70c. UNTIL 1.4.0 IS INSTALLED: `rvr set k <<EOF` and `rvr set k < file` fail on the installed 1.3.0 ("No input received from stdin", fixed by #221) — pipe the value or pass "$(cat file)"; and plain `rvr get` fails on an entry whose text holds an unresolved dollar-brace reference (fixed by #230) — read it with `get -s`.

THEME: v1.4.0 = FORUM (#186, picked 2026-09-04). Milestone 'v1.4.0 — Forum' is the release gate: every issue in it closes before the tag. SCOPE (owner decisions 2026-11-24): #189 and #186 ARE v1.4.0 release items — a cut proposed earlier that day (front page only, #189 and steps 3–4 to the next minor) was REVERSED, do not re-propose it. Steps 3–4 are filed in the milestone as #226 (open questions, builds on #140) and #227 (compaction, builds on #84). DONE (detail in CHANGELOG [Unreleased]): #187, #188, #211, #207 ([[context.sessionDetection]]), #220, #221, #215 step 1 via #222 ([[context.unreadableStoreFiles]]), and all seven gating bugs, merged 2026-11-25: #228 (#192 #203 #204 #206), #229 (#225), #230 (#202, [[context.readFallback]]), #232 (#216 #224, [[context.keyCollisions]]). #229 and #230 each had an independent review on the branch already merged with main: one defect in #229, seven in #230, all reproduced and fixed before the merge. One more was found only after #230 landed and fixed the same day by #233: `set` ran its new reference check on a value typed at the masked prompt and could print part of it ([[context.codeqlPrBlindSpot]]). main's tree (cc3940e) is the one that passed 1885 tests, and its only open CodeQL alert is #17. OPEN IN THE MILESTONE, all needing design first: #189, #215 steps 2–3, #226, #227 — designed in docs/design-189-forum-threads.md (merged via #231): seven owner decisions O1–O7, ten slices, slices 1–2 startable once O1 is answered. #186 closes last. MERGED 2026-11-25 as #235 (7ea30ec): a refused write records INVALID_INPUT on every surface — the CLI text-mode row said RUNTIME (handleError's KeyCollisionError branch recorded no code), MCP rows carried none, lint's collision branch said RUNTIME. CHANGED IN #230 WITHOUT AN OWNER DECISION (in the PR body; say so if asked): `get --source --json` returns the stored text (JSON mode ignored --source), and an error the read does not recognize now fails a listing or reverie_get instead of coming back as the raw value. In #229: the give-up warning is on stderr, code STDIN_SILENT. FOUND, no issue yet: (1) a leaf and a key under it both on disk, which a git merge of two legal writes can leave — the store loads one and the next full save deletes the other, lint passes (review of #232; belongs with #215); (2) `get --json` returns the raw value for a `:?` or a cycle where plain `get` fails; (3) a value that completes a cycle is stored without a word, and both entries then fail every read; (4) default `lint` in a project does not see a global entry in a namespace the project also has.

RELEASE v1.4.0: docs/release-checklist.md carries the steps, the security-audit gate and the v1.4.0 smoke lines. Beyond it: exercise the MCP surface deliberately (#191 and #218 changed both, MCP gets no ambient use); compiled-binary validation per [[context.bunCompileGotchas]]; stale-tag comm check per [[context.releaseTagNamespace]]; watch the release workflow (first run of the action bumps). #213 stays open and unmilestoned — #191 only remaps the two legacy defaults; the owner's Mac holds a hand-set bootstrap_max_response_bytes of 140000 that the remap skips — lower or unset it after installing 1.4.0, then read a week of context rows (pinned/indexed/demotedNamespaces) to calibrate the pinned default.

UNEXERCISED UNTIL THE NEXT TAG: the release.yml bumps (#200 upload-artifact 7.0.2, #201 download-artifact 8.0.2, #214 action-gh-release 3.0.4) — SHAs checked against upstream tags, never run. #191 went in on 1549 tests + CodeQL, no code review. Dependency handling: [[context.dependabotOverrides]].

EXTERNAL DATASET 2026-10-30 → issues #202–#213, see [[context.channelFit]]. Overlaps with prior filings: D2=#192, D4⊂#137 (#207 is the cheap partial), D7=#190.

SOAK: the v1.3.0 soak (clock 2026-07-23) hit the 14d cap without an eval; the Sept theme pick superseded it. Next soak pegs to v1.4.0.

SECURITY AND QUALITY TRACK: the owner said 2026-11-24 that CodeQL and other security and quality findings are addressed separately — do not file them into the release milestone (read here as a track of their own; when it runs was not said). DONE 2026-11-25/26: no open code-scanning, Dependabot or secret-scanning alerts; #236 cleared 69 dependency advisories that Dependabot never showed ([[context.dependencyScanBlind]]), #238 makes a failed scan file an issue. GHSAs: #158 and #159 PUBLISHED as GHSA-cchh-h245-wgr7 and GHSA-62qw-v74v-wxc6 (<= 1.2.2, patched 1.3.0); #234's spelling bypass is DRAFT GHSA-9653-mh42-mfjj, held until 1.4.0 is tagged — the release checklist's Post-release step publishes it. Source records in docs/security/advisory-*.md; scoping in [[context.ghsaExecOnRead]]. The 1.3.0 CHANGELOG section never mentioned the #158/#159 fixes (owner's call whether to add them). CONFIRM GATE, MERGED 2026-11-25 as #234 (272d70c): the gate came loose three ways, all in 1.3.0 — another spelling of a key ran a flagged command unasked wherever the filesystem folds names (`rvr run commands.DEPLOY` on macOS; also references, aliases, MCP), `confirm set` flagged keys that name nothing, and a namespace rename left its entries' flags behind. What shipped, the two approaches dropped after review and the owner's two decisions are in [[context.confirmGate]]. NOT INDEPENDENTLY REVIEWED: the last commits, which apply those decisions (a rename only adds flags; `confirm set` refuses only a key that names no entry, and a namespace) — the owner chose to merge before a fourth review; they passed 1,977 tests, 16 mutations and a 600-sequence differential check against main. USER-VISIBLE CHANGE TO REMEMBER: after any rename the old name stays in `rvr confirm list` until `rvr confirm remove` clears it. FOUND ON MAIN DURING THE REVIEWS, NO ISSUE YET (all still true after #234): (a) exec output is re-scanned — when a command run through a dollar-paren exec reference prints text that is itself an exec reference, that text is interpolated and executed, past the gate; (b) an MCP confirm_token is bound to the key argument only, so a token minted through an alias runs whatever the alias points to when it is used; (c) a write under a Unicode-fold spelling (`rvr set commandſ.deploy x`, U+017F) overwrites the file of commands.deploy — #232's check lower-cases and misses it; (d) a flag lives in one store's list, so a project-list flag on a global entry does not apply outside that project; (e) rename through another spelling of the source copies the entry and reports it renamed; (f) `confirm set` / `alias set` outside any project print a stack trace in text mode; (g) removing an entry drops its flag even when the same key in the other store still reads; (h) a project list holding false for a key shadows a global true (hand-written file only); (i) a rename while the other store's confirmation list is unreadable carries no flag from it.

CARRIED CANDIDATES (unmilestoned): #137 session derivation, #136 retrospective, #139 audit value controls, #140 miss-paths, #84 entry health, #42 git-freshness, #45 attribution; ex-Find #13 fuzzy finder, #43 boolean search, #47 rvr diff; from the 2026-10-30 dataset #208 --append, #209 find-and-replace, #210 SessionStart hook recipe.

RELEASE MAP: v1.4.0 Forum (#186) / v1.5.0 Reach (#6 #49) / v1.6.0 Share (#115) / v1.7.0 Scale (#44 #48 #143) / v1.8.0 Surfaces (#51) / v2.0.0 (#128, Sept 2027).

TIER-3 REFACTOR BACKLOG: import-pipeline unification, rename/copy core, paths.ts walk dedup, registerTool migration, load() snapshot memo. NON-ENGINEERING: [[project.commercialContext]], launch comms, visual identity.
